Streaming chat completion with multiple choice outputs (n > 1)

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4o', n: 2, stream: true)).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
